QuestInfo.name: [Board Game] The Maple Board Game
QuestInfo.0: In time for the super hot summer, super fun Board Game is available in the Maple World... how about participating in it?
QuestInfo.1: Get your hands on some Dice to participate in the Maple Board Game!
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Admin will give you a Dice every 10 minutes. To join the game, just click on the dice icon on the left side of the screen or double-click the dice in the Set-up tab!
